data.one_liner: Dead‑simple field and object schema validation for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Define validation schemas with EzValidator and validate data objects. It returns a map of field errors or processed data synchronously. Supports custom and conditional rules.
use_when: validating form inputs in Flutter widgets
defining reusable data schemas for API responses
adding custom validation logic without code generation
avoid_when: requiring extensive code‑gen or annotation‑based models
high‑performance validation of massive data sets
strengths: very easy to integrate and use
supports conditional, custom, and nested validation
weaknesses: small ecosystem compared to larger validation libraries

alternatives.name: email_validator
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need simple email format validation without full schema support
